items.title: Stock Radar: Sun Pharma breaks out from falling trendline resistance to hit fresh 52-week high; time to buy?
items.description: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd has broken out from a falling trendline resistance on weekly charts, hitting a fresh 52-week high. Experts suggest short-term traders can buy the stock for a target of Rs 1,990 in the next 2-4 months, with a stop loss below Rs 1,690.
